mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.goods_id as goodsId, c.user_id as userId, g.name as goodsName, g.img as goodsImg, g.price as goodsPrice, g.stock as goodsStock, g.sale_status as goodsSaleStatus FROM collect c LEFT JOIN goods g ON c.goods_id = g.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
